title: Tech Note: Deployment Options for a 4D Database
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Still fully relevant: the three deployment models described (user-executed app, Windows Service, headless mode) remain the current options for running 4D Server today, with headless mode continuing to be the modern, cross-platform preferred approach for automated/server deployments.
related_updates: Headless mode (--headless CLI flag) has continued to be developed in newer 4D releases and remains the recommended approach for CI/containerized/server deployments on both macOS and Windows.
No architectural change since — this is general operational guidance, not tied to a specific deprecated feature.
